purpose: Maps the personas of the `access` blocks (the role matrix and the IDOR rows of docs/uat/*/uat.json) to the fixture users of the e2e stack (apps/web/e2e/support/e2e-fixtures.json, `?devUser=<key>` on the web, the development session token of scripts/dev-session-token.mjs at the API). A persona with `fixture_user: null` has no person in the stack: its rows stay NOT RUN in a run against the stack, and are measured by the jest UAT tests of apps/api/test/uat, which make a membership with exactly the rights of the persona (world.as).
generated_from: apps/web/e2e/support/e2e-fixtures.json (the rights of each fixture user)
anonymous_row: A request without a credential is answered 401 whatever the case declares in deny_status: deny_status says what a persona that is signed in and not allowed gets (403, or 404 where the record must not be told to exist).
urls: A URL of an access block names its record as ${id} (or ${code}) and its `resolve` reads one from the measured database: a row of the measured tenant, or of another tenant for the isolation cases. node scripts/uat-db-cases.mjs fills them; where the environment holds no such row the row of the case is NOT RUN with that reason.
